ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed ADV 490 SMA Social Media Analytics (SP 63850 and FA 66376) should not register for ADV 480. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. *Eligible for the PR Minor: https://media.illinois.edu/pr_minor. If available, seats may open to juniors, seniors, and grad students on campus on November 17.
